comment: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares (T19.2). php lists the PHP minor versions that the suite runs on: setup-php installs the latest patch of a minor and cannot pin a patch, so the minor is the pin and each run records the patch it ran on in var/full-run.json. composer is the exact Composer version of every run. python is the Python minor version of the suite: setup-python installs the latest patch of a minor, so the minor is the pin.
